$$$TRACE(" OnProcessInput method ") set tsc=$$$OK //get contents of inbound stream Set hl7Data=pInput.Read(,.tsc) $$$TRACE(" ###DATA: ["_hl7Data_"]") //make sure Read went OK If $$$ISERR(tsc) do $System.Status.DisplayError(tsc) //create request object to send Set tRequest=##class(IHC.ITF.Request.AmWellHttpsRequest).%New() Set tRequest.AmWellHl7Msg.RawContent= hl7Data //send to lookup process Set tsc=..SendRequestSync("AmWell-Demogr-Hl7_Cdr",tRequest,.tResponse) //define output for OnProcessInput Set pOutput=tResponse Do pOutput.WriteLine("Your input Headers:
") If $D(pInput.Attributes("HttpRequest")) Set tTyp=pInput.Attributes("HttpRequest") Do pOutput.WriteLine("HttpRequest = "_tTyp_" "_pInput.Attributes("HttpRequest",tTyp)_"
") Set k="" For Set k=$O(pInput.Attributes(k)) Quit:""=k Do:"HttpRequest"'=k pOutput.WriteLine(k_" = "_pInput.Attributes(k)_"
") Do pOutput.WriteLine("") Do pOutput.WriteLine("
Your input Body("_pInput.Size_"):
") Do pOutput.CopyFrom(pInput) Do pOutput.WriteLine("
done.") Do pOutput.WriteLine("
|"_tResponse.FieldValue_"|.") Do pOutput.WriteLine("") $$$TRACE(" ### ["_tsc_"]") Quit tsc
